device.title: This device
device.description: These settings stay in this browser. They do not change your channel.

engagement.title: Greetings and streaks
engagement.description: Choose which moments the bot greets, how long it waits between greetings, and which watch streaks it celebrates.
engagement.error: Could not load the greeting settings.
engagement.invalid: Fix the numbers marked in red to save.

firstTime.title: First message ever
firstTime.description: Greet a viewer the first time they chat in your channel.

returning.title: Back after a break
returning.description: Welcome a viewer who has not chatted for a while.

streak.title: Watch streaks
streak.description: Celebrate a viewer who watches stream after stream.

cooldown.title: Time between greetings
cooldown.description: The bot greets at most one viewer in this time. Use 0 for no limit.

milestones.title: Streak milestones
milestones.description: The bot celebrates a viewer when their streak reaches one of these counts.
milestones.empty: No milestones. Add one to celebrate streaks.

basics.title: Basics
basics.description: How the bot starts commands, which language it uses and when it is active in your chat.
basics.loadFailed: The basics could not be loaded.
basics.saveFailed: The basics could not be saved.

prefix.title: Command prefix
prefix.description: The first characters of a command, such as !. One to five characters, no spaces.

botLinePrefix.title: Bot line marker
botLinePrefix.description: Shown before lines the bot posts through your own account. Leave empty for none.

locale.title: Language
locale.description: The default language of the bot's replies.

timezone.title: Timezone
timezone.description: Used for schedules and for times shown in replies.

autoJoin.title: Join chat automatically
autoJoin.description: The bot joins your chat by itself when it starts.

readability.title: Readability
readability.description: How text looks for you on every page. Chat has its own layout options in its Display panel.
readability.footer: Changes apply at once and are saved on this device.

presets.title: Start from a preset
presets.description: A preset sets all the options below. Change any of them after. Dyslexia-friendly uses Lexend at 16 px with wider spacing and no motion.

text.title: Text
text.description: The sample below shows each change at once.

sample.heading: A page heading
sample.body: Body text reads like this on every page.
sample.pangram: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. 0123456789

font.title: Font
font.description: Legible is Atkinson Hyperlegible. Lexend was made for reading ease.

size.title: Text size
size.description: Scales all text on every page.

contrast.title: High contrast
contrast.description: Quiet text becomes full strength and edges get stronger.

motion.title: Reduce motion
motion.description: Follow system uses the setting of your computer or phone.

density.title: Density
density.description: Compact fits the most on a desktop. Touch makes every button, tab and row at least 44 px tall.
